reviewers.summary: The rendered avatar and camera assertions address the prior missing-target coverage, but they run with the session override enabled rather than the system preference. The production path under system reduced motion remains unverified.

findingList.message: The rendered-scene assertions cover the session override, but not system reduced motion. Inject the test motion instance configured with `matches: true` into the scene controllers and verify both rendered targets under that preference.

evidence.codePathTraced: The rendered-scene test creates controllers without passing its `motion` instance, then enables reduced motion through `controllers.motion.setOverride(true)`. Its rendered avatar and camera assertions therefore exercise the session override, not the operating-system preference.
evidence.failureScenario: If the production scene stops applying the system reduced-motion preference to rendered camera and avatar transitions, this test still passes because it activates the session override instead. The carried test finding requiring production-path assertions under system reduced motion remains unresolved.

reviewers.summary: The new assertions check that rendered camera and avatar targets update under the session override. They do not verify that production scene transitions honor the operating-system preference without an override.

findingList.message: The carried test finding remains: rendered camera and avatar transitions are asserted only with a session override, not with the system reduced-motion preference. Exercise the rendered scene with system reduction active and no override.

evidence.codePathTraced: The rendered-scene test creates its controllers without injecting the system-reduced `motion`, then explicitly enables the session override at line 69. The separate system-preference test exercises helpers and controllers without rendering the production scene.
evidence.failureScenario: If the production scene stops honoring the operating-system preference, the rendered test still passes because its session override forces reduced motion. With the system preference active and no override, a camera or avatar transition could animate while the suite stays green.

reviewers.summary: The updated scene test now checks the rendered avatar position and camera target after navigation under reduced motion. I found no security vulnerability or remaining carried finding in the reviewed change.
